features.bend-radius-front: 1/2 in (12.7 mm) at the front fingers, transitions and pass-throughs
features.bend-radius-rear: 3/8 in (9.5 mm) at the rear fingers

performance.cable-capacity-basis: front channel: 0.185 in (4.70 mm, Cat 6A 28 AWG) cable at the 30% recommended fill of its 6 sq in usable area; 111 at the 50% maximum fill - Panduit Cable Capacity Calculator V14
performance.cable-capacity-rear-basis: rear channel: 0.185 in (4.70 mm, Cat 6A 28 AWG) cable at the 30% recommended fill of its 8 sq in usable area; 148 at the 50% maximum fill - Panduit Cable Capacity Calculator V14

physical.cover-material: polycarbonate front cover, PVC rear cover
physical.mounting-hardware: four combination slotted round head screws, 12-24 x 3/4 in

gaps.note: the specification sheet says the hinged front cover opens 180 degrees up or down; no view draws a hinge, and the cover is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of the cover's hinge

gaps.note: the plan view draws the rear fingers as arches seen end-on from above; eleven were counted with an end piece at each side. Twelve, as the front's, are drawn; the length of the rear fingers is estimated.
gaps.wanted: a rear elevation of the manager with its cover off

gaps.note: Panduit's NCMH2 DXF holds a single note that the drawing is not available on the web, no geometry, so every figure is read from the PDF drawing.
gaps.wanted: the NCMH2 DXF or DWG with its geometry

gaps.note: no view sections the covers or the fingers: their thickness is estimated and the elevations draw the body without the covers' edges.
gaps.wanted: a section through a cover and a finger tip
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards, bend radii and what is in the box are the NCMH2 product page and the specification sheet (RKSP225); the screws are the drawing's note 2.

bottom.note: drawing - the front view draws the same finger arches along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - Panduit's Cable Capacity Calculator (V14) gives the NCMH2's front usable area as 6 sq in and its rear 8, and for its entered cable (0.185 in, 4.70 mm, Cat 6A 28 AWG) at the 30 per cent recommended fill 66 front and 89 rear (111 and 148 at the 50 per cent maximum). The Space-Saving bulletin's charts do not list the NCMH2. Not divided among the fingers.

chassis.note: drawing - 444.83 x 88.14 x 247.71. The NCMH2 drawing dimensions 482.59 [19.00 in] over the ears, 465.07 [18.31 in] between the fixing holes, 88.14 [3.47 in] high, 444.83 [17.51 in] across the body between the ears and 247.71 [9.75 in] deep; the RKSP225 table gives the same (482.6 x 88.1 x 247.7). The ears are not drawn.

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the covers are drawn a shade lighter than the moulding.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The NCMH2 drawing (Panduit 00787-07) dimensions the plan 247.71 [9.75 in] overall in two parts, "3.24 REF [82.27]" for the front section and "6.51 REF [165.43]" for the rest; the NCMHF2 drawing (00787-10) dimensions the front-only manager "3.74 REF [95.10]" with the same 3.24 front, so the plate and flange are the 13 behind the front section. `at` is 82.27, so the ears bolt to the front face of the plate. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front with the hinged cover fitted: the cover, and under it the two rows of twelve fingers end-on, the channel between them and the two windows in the plate at the back of it. The drawing shows the front "cover removed for clarity". The `duct` guide is the channel between the finger rows, 60 high (the 88.14 less two 14.07 rows, estimated); the pitch is the 34.925 that the fingers (25.4) and their spacing (9.5, stated by RKSP225) add up to.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the part is 247.71 deep with 82.27 of it in front of the rails and 165.43 behind them; it does not reach the rear rails of a rack 600 mm deep or more, so the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - each duct is the channel between its two finger rows, run across the rack; the pitch and the gap are RKSP225's finger spacing (3/8 in, 9.5 mm) added to the 25.4 finger the drawing's 34.9 pitch leaves. The rear duct's height is the front's.

left.note: estimated - no side view is drawn. The end of the manager is the two channels' finger-row walls and the plate, built from the plan view and the front view.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DRAWING. Panduit publishes the NCMH2 as a customer drawing (PDF 00787-07: dimensioned front, plan, weight and materials), a DXF that holds only a note ("due to file size this drawing is not available on the web", no geometry), a DWG that was not fetched, the NetManager Horizontal Cable Managers specification sheet RKSP225, the CM223B installation sheet, a product page and the Cable Capacity Calculator. The plan and front views are vector drawings read at 300 dpi against their own 444.83 [17.51 in] dimension. THE FIGURES THE DRAWING DIMENSIONS ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURE (the rear finger count, the windows, the finger's width and length) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

rear.note: estimated - the rear channel from behind: the snap-on cover, and under it the two rows of twelve fingers end-on and the windows open in the floor. The plan counts about as many arches as the front's; the count is estimated (see `gaps:`).

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX. The body is a sheet body (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4) and its six views are elevations. The solid is what its parts build: the plate on the front view as a well 82.27 deep with the two finger walls and the cover in it; on the rear view the plate's back as a well 152.41 deep with its two finger walls and the snap-on cover; both floors open at the two windows.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states a wall gauge for the polycarbonate moulding. 2.5 is a moulded wall of this size; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: drawing - the plan view, rear at y=0: the rear fingers 100 mm long, the plate and flange 13.03 deep, then the front fingers 70 mm long. Read at 300 dpi; the fingers' lengths are estimated.

weight.note: drawing - 1283.7 g [2.83 lb], the weight table of the NCMH2 customer drawing (00787-07).
